# anthropic_claude_tag_bundle_target (Resource)

Experimental. Attaches a Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) Bundle to a Slack channel or a Slack workspace (`/v1/organizations/claude_tag/bundles/{bundle_id}/targets`). A Bundle attached to a workspace can be used in every channel in it. The channel or workspace must already be set up. All arguments force replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach a Bundle (created in claude.ai) to one channel.
resource "anthropic_claude_tag_bundle_target" "channel" {
  bundle_id        = "capp_00000000"
  slack_channel_id = anthropic_claude_tag_slack_channel.example.id
}

# Attach a Bundle to a whole Slack workspace.
data "anthropic_claude_tag_slack_workspaces" "example" {
  slack_workspace_id = "T00000000"
}

resource "anthropic_claude_tag_bundle_target" "workspace" {
  bundle_id          = "capp_00000000"
  slack_workspace_id = data.anthropic_claude_tag_slack_workspaces.example.workspaces[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bundle_id` (String) Identifier of the Bundle to attach (`capp_...`).

### Optional

- `slack_channel_id` (String) Claude Tag Slack channel identifier (`slch_...`), the `id` of `anthropic_claude_tag_slack_channel`, not Slack's `C...` channel ID. Exactly one of `slack_channel_id` or `slack_workspace_id` is required.
- `slack_workspace_id` (String) Claude Tag Slack workspace identifier (`slws_...`), not Slack's `T...` workspace ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the Bundle was attached.
- `id` (String) Bundle Target identifier (`btgt_...`).
- `type` (String) Target type: `slack_channel` or `slack_workspace`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <bundle_id>/<target_id>.
terraform import anthropic_claude_tag_bundle_target.channel capp_00000000/btgt_00000000
```
